Hi Elena —

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. To get Solarius set up in our procurement system and raise PO-45291, we need the following tax onboarding items from your side:

- Completed, signed IRS W-9 (or W-8BEN-E if you operate as a foreign entity)
- Official company EIN/TIN (matching the form)
- Remit-to address and banking instructions (ACH preferred)
- A short copy of your W-9 signatory authority (name + title)

I've attached our PO intake template to show the fields we'll populate once tax is cleared. If you prefer, feel free to return a completed W-9 and either a bank letter or an IRS confirmation screenshot.

Goal: have tax evidence on file so we can issue the PO by end of next week. Can you confirm timeline?

Thanks,

Jordan / Monica —

Quick update after Tax Ops ran the W-9 through our verification checks: the EIN on the attached W-9 (12-3456789) did not match the TIN returned by the IRS crosswalk (system returned 123456789 without dash), and the automated match flagged an inconsistency. This has put PO-45291 into "tax hold" in Coupa until we get corroborating evidence.

Options to clear the hold (ranked by speed):
1) Send a screenshot or PDF of the IRS EIN confirmation page for the EIN shown on your W-9 (acceptable if dated within the last 90 days).
2) Provide a scanned copy of the IRS CP575 or equivalent EIN issuance letter.
3) A notarized affidavit from Solarius finance confirming the EIN and signatory authority (we accept notarized PDFs).

If none of the above are immediately available, we can provisionally create a non-invoicable PO for testing (zero-dollar) to allow initial identity-confirmation workflows, but we cannot release funds until verification is complete.

Monica / Dylan, can you confirm whether we want to 1) hold the PO and request docs, or 2) issue a provisional zero-dollar PO to allow integration testing while we chase evidence?

Thanks — I'll copy the vendor on next steps once we have a decision.

Aisha Rahman
Senior Manager, Vendor Onboarding
